reviews.title: Absolutely terrible and unprofessional airline
reviews.text: I can not begin to describe how terrible my entire experience with Jordan Aviation was. My wife and I could tell when we were booking that they seemed like a budget airline, which didn't bother us. We checked their website the morning of our flight to make sure everything was ok and got a confirmation message. When we arrived at the airport the flight was not on the departure board. When speaking to the counter and showing them our confirmation, they had no idea what we were talking about and told us that there was no flight to Beirut that day. After some time with several different people talking and "looking into" the situation we were told that our flight had been cancelled four days before, which we had NOT been told about. When I asked what they were going to do to help us, we were basically told to book a flight through another airline since they don't have a flight to Beirut. I asked if they could talk to the other airline about a discount since they messed up the situation and they said that wasn't possible. I was told we would get a refund immediately to my credit card which didn't happen. My wife and I then received emails 30 minutes prior to the original departure time telling us that the flight was cancelled and asking for how to process the refund. I responded to this email the next day and sent a follow up email a week later with no response from either. It is clear they didn't want to refund our tickets so I went through my bank to do so. "Coincidentally" I finally got an email response the day that my bank handled the dispute and got my money back. Overall the entire experience was a nightmare. The "customer service" if it can be called that was so unprofessional and I sincerely hope that this review helps some people decide to book through literally ANY other ariline.

I have a teacup poodle that always travels with me in cabin, I made sure that he was able to travel with me and made arrangements in advance, not to mention his ticket price was more expensivw than mine. Upon reaching the airport, the jordan aviation counter told me they don’t accept pets on to cabin and he must go into cargo, I pulled up their website and showed them thwir own policy and they said the rules have changed sorry we didn’t update the website and the system and our colleague must not have been aware of the rule changes or else you would’ve been informed. How is that even my problem, too bad, you call yourselves an airline and can’t even modify or update your terms and policies!! After having no choice I had to call a nearby petstore and beg them to send me a hard cage with a taxi to give my poor 2kg dog to the cargo!! They are an unprofessional nightmare, anywhere else in the world they would’ve been sued for such incompetence and the audacity they had, sorry nothing we can do about it! The airplane was old, dirty and uncomfortable. And the they still haven’t updated their website or policies.
